name: dsh-whats-up
description: What's up for DeepSeek Harness: scans ~/.dsh/sessions on the host, extracts a goal + one-line status for every conversation (LLM, cached by fingerprint), classifies half-done / unanswered / recent / done, and answers 'what's up?' in one panel — a zero-maintenance todo board. Click any card to jump back into that session. · DSH 会话动态面板:host 端扫描会话流,为每个会话提取「目标 + 一句话现状」,自动发现做到一半/问了没回/近期在推进的事,点卡片直接跳回会话——一个不用手动维护的待办看板。
